0.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05004_000010_MYSTERYVOICE
0.description: Ah, there you are. May I assume you've had your fill of rest?

1.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05004_000020_MYSTERYVOICE
1.description: That is well. Now that we are all present, let us speak of our plan.

2.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05004_000030_MYSTERYVOICE
2.description: Thus far, we have vanquished four Lightwardens, restoring night to much of Norvrandt.

3.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05004_000040_MYSTERYVOICE
3.description: Only one remains─that of Kholusia. And with Ryne to guide us, I am certain we will find it.

4.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05004_000050_ALISAIE
4.description: We're so close now. If we can just take care of this one last Warden, we'll rob the sin eaters of their final foothold, and drive them out of Norvrandt once and for all.

5.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05004_000060_ALISAIE
5.description: It will be a new beginning for the First─a chance for the people to rebuild their world.

6.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05004_000070_ALPHINAUD
6.description: In short, a prize worth fighting for.

7.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05004_000080_URIANGER
7.description: And in thus delivering the First from destruction, so too shall we unsow the seeds of the Eighth Umbral Calamity.

8.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05004_000090_YSHTOLA
8.description: Do you hear? Your dreamed-of Rejoining is in jeopardy. Are you sure you're not tempted to intervene?

10.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05004_000110_EMETSELCH
10.description: You labor under the misapprehension that vanquishing the sin eaters is tantamount to saving the world. It is not.

11.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05004_000120_EMETSELCH
11.description: In truth, you only delay the inevitable, lengthening your fleeting lives by the smallest of margins.

12.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05004_000130_EMETSELCH
12.description: 'Twould be churlish of me to deny you this small concession, close as we've become. Foolish and misguided though you are, you are not without charm.

13.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05004_000140_EMETSELCH
13.description: Each and every one of you is possessed of a noble heart. When the weak want for succor, you do not hesitate to provide it.

14.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05004_000150_EMETSELCH
14.description: Alas, your nobility is shortsighted. You think only of the problem in front of your nose.

15.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05004_000160_EMETSELCH
15.description: A limitation of your ephemeral existence.

16.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05004_000170_ALPHINAUD
16.description: Our lives may seem short and insignificant to the likes of you. But one does not need to be an eternal being to achieve lasting change.

17.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05004_000180_EMETSELCH
17.description: Ah, if I may stop you there─I do not claim that we Ascians are <hex:021A020203>special<hex:021A020103>. That is another misconception.

18.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05004_000190_EMETSELCH
18.description: In the beginning, everyone─<hex:021A020203>everyone<hex:021A020103> lived nigh for eternity. Such was the natural order of things. But like so much else, this was taken from you.

19.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05004_000200_EMETSELCH
19.description: You won't object if I borrow your plaything.

20.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05004_000210_EMETSELCH
20.description: In the distant past, when the world was one and whole, a great calamity threatened all life.

21.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05004_000220_EMETSELCH
21.description: It began without warning. The very laws of the star were warped and broken, and chaos swiftly spread throughout the land.

22.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05004_000230_EMETSELCH
22.description: Faced with annihilation, we sought to imbue the star with its own will. Thus was Zodiark born, and by His power was order restored.

23.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05004_000240_EMETSELCH
23.description: Ere long, however, thankless fools began to fear that Zodiark's might was too great. And so they conjured another to keep Him in check─your own dear Hydaelyn.

24.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05004_000250_YSHTOLA
24.description: And the two beings waged war until, with a single, devastating blow, Hydaelyn unmade Zodiark, scattering his being across space and time. So you told us in the Qitana Ravel.

25.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05004_000260_EMETSELCH
25.description: Yes, yes... And <hex:021A020203>there<hex:021A020103> began our woes─with Hydaelyn's blow, and all that it wrought.

26.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05004_000270_EMETSELCH
26.description: As a counterbalance to Zodiark, Hydaelyn was created with the power to enervate Her foe.

27.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05004_000280_EMETSELCH
27.description: This singular ability strikes not at such banal things as flesh, but <hex:021A020203>everything<hex:021A020103> that defines the target, diluting its existence.

28.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05004_000290_EMETSELCH
28.description: For example, were She to strike you...

29.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05004_000300_EMETSELCH
29.description: Two individuals, identical in appearance, yet reduced in all respects. Strength, intelligence, the soul itself─all is halved.

30.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05004_000310_EMETSELCH
30.description: Do you see? This selfsame fate befell not only Zodiark, but the very star.

31.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05004_000320_EMETSELCH
31.description: Only three were fortunate enough to escape the sundering─me being one of them.

32.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05004_000330_EMETSELCH
32.description: When I beheld the shattered remnants of our home, I knew deepest despair.

33.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05004_000340_EMETSELCH
33.description: The inhabitants of these fourteen fragments were feeble, frail, and foolish. Oblivious to their imperfection, ignorant of their past.

34.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05004_000350_EMETSELCH
34.description: Malformed creatures thrashing blindly about. Pitiful. Disturbing. Depressing.

35.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05004_000360_EMETSELCH
35.description: So we took it upon ourselves to rejoin the worlds. But in our eagerness─and, I confess, our ignorance─we erred, and made a useless void of the Thirteenth.

36.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05004_000370_EMETSELCH
36.description: It was only afterwards that we discovered a connection 'twixt Source and shard─a flow of energy that maintains elemental balance. And thus did we arrive at our time-honored modus operandi.

37.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05004_000380_YSHTOLA
37.description: From a purely Ascian standpoint, it could be said that what you seek to do is only logical.

38.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05004_000390_YSHTOLA
38.description: But that would be to ignore the immeasurable destruction wrought with each Rejoining. You have murdered millions. And this we cannot condone.

39.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05004_000400_EMETSELCH
39.description: By your fragmented existence, you continue to give rise to tragedies far crueler than any calamity.

40.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05004_000410_EMETSELCH
40.description: But yes, moral relativism and all that. Case in point─I do not consider you to be truly alive. Ergo, I will not be guilty of murder if I kill you.

41.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05004_000420_EMETSELCH
41.description: Oh, don't look at me like that. You for whom I have only the highest expectations.

42.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05004_000430_EMETSELCH
42.description: A vaunted hero of the Source, seven times rejoined.

43.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05004_000440_EMETSELCH
43.description: Long have I awaited one who might brave a path of lesser tragedy. A resilient soul able to endure the necessary pain. I dare to hope that my wait is over.

44.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05004_000450_EMETSELCH
44.description: So, finish your task and slay the Lightwarden. Make proof of your usefulness. And then we may speak again.

45.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05004_000460_LYNA
45.description: Forgive me, my lord, but this could not wait.

47.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05004_000480_LYNA
47.description: Our informant in Kholusia sends word of unusual activity in Eulmore.

48.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05004_000490_LYNA
48.description: It appears their forces are entrenching themselves at key points throughout the city. Making ready for an attack, by all indications.

49.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05004_000500_MYSTERYVOICE
49.description: An intriguing use of resources. I rather doubt Lord Vauthry is concerned for the safety of his citizens...

50.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05004_000510_ALISAIE
50.description: You think he's harboring the Lightwarden <hex:021A020203>inside<hex:021A020103> the city walls? Even if he does have some means of controlling the sin eaters, wouldn't that be a little risky?

51.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05004_000520_THANCRED
51.description: Risky or not, if there is even a chance the Warden is hiding there, we will need to act fast. The longer we wait, the better prepared the Eulmorans will be.

52.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05004_000530_MYSTERYVOICE
52.description: Agreed. See to your preparations then, and make for Kholusia.

53.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05004_000540_MYSTERYVOICE
53.description: Gods willing, this hunt will be the last. Let us see it through to the end.

54.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05004_000550_ALPHINAUD
54.description: We should begin by assembling in Wright. There we may assess the situation in Eulmore, and decide how best to proceed.

56.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05004_000570_URIANGER
56.description: By their behavior, we may safely assume that they are under Vauthry's mind control.

57.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05004_000580_URIANGER
57.description: Yet the extent of the effect seemeth to vary dramatically between subjects.

58.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05004_000590_URIANGER
58.description: 'Tis far too pronounced to be attributed simply to the vagaries of innate magical resistance.

60.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05004_000610_ALPHINAUD
60.description: We met with no trouble en route. My thanks for securing the way.

61.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05004_000620_ALPHINAUD
61.description: But given the state of the townsfolk, I see we were never in any danger of being recognized.

62.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05004_000630_THANCRED
62.description: What can you tell us from here?

63.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05004_000640_RYNE
63.description: I sense a powerful eater...in the uppermost reaches of the city...

64.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05004_000650_RYNE
64.description: But there's something different about it. Its Light is...impure.

67.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05004_000680_ALPHINAUD
67.description: Kai-Shirr! What are you doing here?

68.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05004_000690_ALISAIE
68.description: While I was scouting the area, I noticed a suspicious figure skulking about.

69.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05004_000700_ALISAIE
69.description: So I accosted him─only to have him call me “Alphinaud.” I thought it best to bring him along.

70.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05004_000710_KAISHIRR
70.description: You see...that informant who's been feeding secrets to the Crystarium...it's me.

71.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05004_000720_KAISHIRR
71.description: See, after you saved my life in Eulmore, I thought about going somewhere far away. But I couldn't just leave, not without paying you back.

72.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05004_000730_KAISHIRR
72.description: So I decided to stay here─keep an eye on things. And whenever I spotted something strange, I shared it with your friends.

73.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05004_000740_ALPHINAUD
73.description: That took no small amount of courage. Well done.

74.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05004_000750_THANCRED
74.description: I assume you saw what happened here.

75.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05004_000760_KAISHIRR
75.description: Right, so, an airship flew in a bit ago, and not long after, Vauthry starts ranting and raving. You could hear him from all the way out here!

76.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05004_000770_KAISHIRR
76.description: Geezer was doing his nut! Shouting and screaming like someone had nicked his pie!

77.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05004_000780_URIANGER
77.description: 'Tis like the airship bore the soldiers sent to thwart our efforts in Amh Araeng.

78.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05004_000790_KAISHIRR
78.description: So eventually the yelling dies down...and then this hot, sticky wind comes blowing through.

79.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05004_000800_KAISHIRR
79.description: Now that's when everyone went funny. Everyone but me. Well, me and a couple of newcomers, though even they started mumbling about Vauthry after a while. Not as bad as the rest, mind you.

81.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05004_000820_YSHTOLA
81.description: There's something I need Ryne to see.

82.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05004_000830_YSHTOLA
82.description: This was among the townsfolk's food stores.

83.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05004_000840_KAISHIRR
83.description: Oh, that's just meol. Eulmore doles the stuff out.

85.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05004_000860_RYNE
85.description: I─ I know what it is.

86.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05004_000870_RYNE
86.description: It's sin eater. Meol is made out of sin eater.

88.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05004_000890_YSHTOLA
88.description: In limited quantities, it may have little effect on an average individual.

89.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05004_000900_YSHTOLA
89.description: Yet if one were to consume it regularly, over a period of several years, I suspect it would do far, far more than merely nourish the body...

90.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05004_000910_URIANGER
90.description: That Vauthry wieldeth power over sin eaters is known. Could it be that those who partake of their flesh do thereby render themselves susceptible to his influence?

91.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05004_000920_URIANGER
91.description: 'Twould serve to explain why the town's newer arrivals succumbed less quickly than those raised on a diet of meol.

92.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05004_000930_ALISAIE
92.description: He's been rounding up sin eaters and feeding them to people!? Altering them mouthful by mouthful─all to stop them answering back!?

93.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05004_000940_ALISAIE
93.description: There are desperate souls out there <hex:021A020203>killing<hex:021A020103> themselves to escape turning! This is unforgivable! An atrocity!

94.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05004_000950_ALPHINAUD
94.description: These sin eaters... What if they are not simply “rounded up”?

95.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05004_000960_ALPHINAUD
95.description: Do you remember what we were told when first we came to the city?

97.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05004_000980_ALPHINAUD
97.description: Let us put an end to it. To this “paradise” built upon the bones of the poor.

98.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05004_000990_ALPHINAUD
98.description: Vauthry's deeds are beyond justification. Beyond forgiveness. Evil.

99.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05004_001000_THANCRED
99.description: It's highly probable that the Lightwarden is waiting for us somewhere in there, and I'm all for going after it.

100.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05004_001010_THANCRED
100.description: But our enemies know our faces. They know that we are coming. And they will not let us through without a fight. Like it or not, the time for stealth is passed.

101.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05004_001020_THANCRED
101.description: Now, my friend. If you would be so good as to lead the charge.

102.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05004_001030_VAUTHRY
102.description: Ugh... I can feel it... A dark presence in my domain!

103.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05004_001040_VAUTHRY
103.description: Ah! It's them! The villains who would sow chaos in my perfect paradise!

104.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05004_001050_VAUTHRY
104.description: Keep them away from me! I command you, keep them awaaaaaay!

106.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05004_001070_THANCRED
106.description: He would use his own people as shields.

107.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05004_001080_ALPHINAUD
107.description: This area is older than Gatetown. There are bound to be far more civilians under Vauthry's control.

108.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05004_001090_ALPHINAUD
108.description: But they do not act of their own free will, and we must not harm them.

110.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05004_001110_ALISAIE
110.description: Press on with Alphinaud. We'll hold off the civilians and join you as soon as we can.

111.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05004_001120_RANJIT
111.description: You will find my master in his chamber...

112.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05004_001130_RANJIT
112.description: But only should you kill me this day─and you will not.

114.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05004_A1_000_001_NONE_VOICE
114.description: Why do you go so far?

115.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05004_A1_000_002_NONE_VOICE
115.description: You're one of his puppets too.

116.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05004_001140_RANJIT
116.description: You may think me under his spell, but I uphold Lord Vauthry's ideals of my own volition.

117.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05004_001150_RANJIT
117.description: Man is an inherently flawed creature. In his vain pursuit of righteousness, he but sows the seeds of future conflict.

118.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05004_001160_RANJIT
118.description: Thus have I chosen to place my hopes upon he who has transcended men. Upon he who is unbound by the vagaries of conscience.

119.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05004_001170_RANJIT
119.description: But enough talk. I am a soldier, and you are my enemy.

120.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05004_001180_RANJIT
120.description: Come! Let us settle this once and for all!

121.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05004_001190_ALPHINAUD
121.description: Lord Vauthry! Your reign of tyranny is at an end.

122.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05004_001200_ALPHINAUD
122.description: For too long, you have preyed upon the desperation of the poor. Now you will answer for the suffering you have caused!

123.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05004_001210_ALPHINAUD
123.description: And if you harbor even a shred of remorse, I beseech you to use your powers to redress the balance. For the future of all in Norvrandt.

124.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05004_001220_RYNE
124.description: No... It can't be. This is wrong. It's <hex:021A020203>wrong<hex:021A020103>!

125.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05004_001230_RYNE
125.description: The Warden─it's not just a sin eater. It's a man!

126.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05004_001240_VAUTHRY
126.description: Remorse? For the future of all? What nonsense is this?

127.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05004_001250_VAUTHRY
127.description: There is no justice but mine. No future but mine. No will but mine.

128.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05004_001260_VAUTHRY
128.description: It is preordained. I was born to deliver this wretched world.

129.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05004_001270_VAUTHRY
129.description: Me? Unseated? No, no, no, no, no...

130.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05004_001280_VAUTHRY
130.description: It's impossible. Inconceivable! <hex:021A020203>Absurd<hex:021A020103>! I am a great and wise king. Greatest and wisest! I reign from on high!

131.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05004_001290_VAUTHRY
131.description: I will not be brought low by maggots like you!

133.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05004_001310_VAUTHRY
133.description: Oh, yes. Of course. I can begin again. Rebuild my paradise. Once I finish my dinner...

134.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05004_001320_RYNE
134.description: Oh gods, no─ Stop him! Thancred, stop him!

140.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05004_A2_000_002_NONE_VOICE
140.description: How will we get up there?

142.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05004_001370_ALPHINAUD
142.description: That is Mt. Gulg, the highest peak in Kholusia. It lies on the other side of a sheer cliff, and much as I wish it were otherwise, it is beyond our reach for now.

143.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05004_001380_ALPHINAUD
143.description: But even if it weren't─there are people here who need our help.

145.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05004_001400_ALPHINAUD
145.description: Please. Even if it's only to tend to their wounds.

151.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05004_001420_RYNE
151.description: I don't know if it will work, but if Vauthry's hold over the people is rooted in Light, I might be able to reverse its effects.

153.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05004_001440_ALPHINAUD
153.description: Of course. We'd be grateful for any help you can provide.

154.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05004_001450_ALISAIE
154.description: Well then, if it's decided, let's all get to work.

155.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05004_001460_RYNE
155.description: You're going to be all right.

156.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05004_001470_ALISAIE
156.description: I think that's the last of them.

157.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05004_001480_ALPHINAUD
157.description: We've done all we can for the wounded.

159.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05004_001500_DULIACHAI
159.description: U-Um...a-aren't you Alphinaud? The painter boy?

160.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05004_001510_DULIACHAI
160.description: What in the world is going on? Did something happen to us?

162.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05004_001530_ALPHINAUD
162.description: Citizens of Eulmore. What I'm about to tell you will come as a shock.

163.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05004_001540_ALPHINAUD
163.description: Indeed, you may be loath to believe it. But if you trust the evidence of your senses, it is my hope that you will listen and accept the truth, unpalatable though it may be.

164.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05004_001550_ALPHINAUD
164.description: Vauthry is a sin eater. Everything he offered, everything he promised, was a lie...

165.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05004_001560_ALISAIE
165.description: They're not taking it well. And who could blame them?

166.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05004_001570_EULMOREPEOPLEA
166.description: Are you saying we were Vauthry's puppets all this time?

167.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05004_001580_ALPHINAUD
167.description: When you attacked us, you were not yourselves. That much is true.

168.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05004_001590_ALPHINAUD
168.description: But your conduct prior to that moment was your own. Vauthry's unnatural charisma does not absolve you of all responsibility.

169.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05004_001600_ALPHINAUD
169.description: Of your own free will, you came to this city and gave yourselves over to its pleasures.

170.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05004_001610_ALPHINAUD
170.description: And in the course of this, if you mistreated those less fortunate than you...then that too was of your own free will.

171.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05004_001620_ALPHINAUD
171.description: It is not for me to judge you, but for your victims. For history. For your conscience.

172.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05004_001630_ALPHINAUD
172.description: You have dreamed a twisted dream, but now you are awake.

173.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05004_001640_ALPHINAUD
173.description: You may yet share this world of ours. Join with us and each other that we might begin anew.

174.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05004_001650_ALPHINAUD
174.description: We've lost so many already. We dare not lose any more.

175.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05004_001660_ALPHINAUD
175.description: I have said my piece. My thanks for giving me the chance.

176.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05004_001670_ALPHINAUD
176.description: There is nothing more to be done here. Let us go after Vauthry.

177.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05004_001680_EULMOREPEOPLEB
177.description: Is there anything we can do to help?

178.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05004_001690_EULMOREPEOPLEB
178.description: You risked your lives to bring us to our senses, a-and I for one hope to repay that debt. Begin anew, as you said.

179.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05004_001700_YSHTOLA
179.description: Vauthry has fled to Mt. Gulg, and we mean to pursue him. Do any of you know the way?

180.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05004_001710_EULMOREPEOPLEC
180.description: The only way to Mt. Gulg is over the Bright Cliff. Have you an airship?

181.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05004_001720_YSHTOLA
181.description: We will contemplate flight only as a last resort. Were we to come under attack whilst airborne, we would have little hope of defending ourselves.

182.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05004_001730_YSHTOLA
182.description: If at all possible, we would prefer to travel by land. Is there a way?

183.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05004_001740_EULMOREPEOPLED
183.description: The Ladder is the only way up and down the cliff, but it hasn't moved in a long time.

184.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05004_001750_EULMOREPEOPLED
184.description: In the old days, it was operated by the mining folk who lived at the top.

185.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05004_001760_EULMOREPEOPLED
185.description: But after the Flood it saw less and less use, and when Lord Vauthry took control, it was abandoned altogether.

186.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05004_001770_ALISAIE
186.description: So we somehow need to get the Ladder working again?

187.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05004_001780_EULMOREPEOPLEC
187.description: It moves by means of a Talos, if that's any help. But good luck repairing that...

189.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05004_001800_DULIACHAI
189.description: You know all about them, don't you, dearest! If anyone can get this lift moving, it's you!

191.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05004_001820_DULIACHAI
191.description: Oh, yes! If you want the golem restored, you may leave it to my husband!

192.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05004_001830_DULIACHAI
192.description: For he happens to be the heir to Daedalus Stoneworks, foremost makers of Talos, whose contracts include the renowned mining venture of Amh Araeng!

193.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05004_001840_CHAINUZZ
193.description: It's... Well, i-i-it's been years and years since I had anything to do with it! I-I can't just pick up a hammer and set to work!

195.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05004_001860_CHAINUZZ
195.description: N-No, th-th-that's not what I─ I-It's just, I─

196.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05004_001870_CHAINUZZ
196.description: ...All right, I will take a look at the Talos, but beyond that, I make no promises!

197.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05004_001880_CHAINUZZ
197.description: Those with strong backs, come with me. I'll need help dragging the damned thing out of the storehouse...

199.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05004_001900_ALPHINAUD
199.description: Come, my friend. We have work to do!

200.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05004_001910_EMETSELCH
200.description: Would you look at that? The citizens of Eulmore engaging in what can only be described as “manual labor.” Who would have thought it possible?

201.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05004_001920_EMETSELCH
201.description: Do you know the most reliable way to deal with those who stubbornly refuse to see reason?

202.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05004_001930_EMETSELCH
202.description: You conquer them─crush them under heel. Such was the trusted method of Allag, and one still favored by Garlemald.

203.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05004_001940_EMETSELCH
203.description: But conquest is the <hex:021A020203>easy<hex:021A020103> part. The true challenge begins once the dust has settled─quenching the glowing embers of animosity and maintaining a semblance of peace.

204.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05004_001950_EMETSELCH
204.description: This requires the conqueror to treat the conquered with dignity, and the conquered to let bygones be bygones. A difficult feat to achieve.

205.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05004_001960_EMETSELCH
205.description: But you have achieved just that...to my considerable surprise.

207.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05004_001980_EMETSELCH
207.description: Ahh, the vibrant energy that fills the air when like-minded souls gather. To think back on that time before time fair brings a tear to the eye.

208.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05004_001990_EMETSELCH
208.description: What? You thought ancient beings like us incapable of crying?

209.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05004_002000_EMETSELCH
209.description: Well, rest assured that if <hex:021A020203>your<hex:021A020103> heart can be broken, then so can mine!

210.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05004_002010_EMETSELCH
210.description: Back when the world was whole, we had family, friends, loves...

211.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05004_002020_EMETSELCH
211.description: Men knew peace and contentment, and with our adamant souls, we could live for an age.

212.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05004_002030_EMETSELCH
212.description: There was no conflict born of want or disparity. Our differences paled into insignificance next to all we had in common.

213.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05004_002040_EMETSELCH
213.description: And then there was Amaurot... Never was a city more magnificent. From the humblest streets to the highest spires, she fairly gleamed...

214.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05004_002050_EMETSELCH
214.description: Not that you would remember any of this.

219.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05004_002070_EMETSELCH
219.description: The point is: the world of old was a far better place than what we have now. I believe you would like it, having witnessed the things you have.

220.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05004_002080_EMETSELCH
220.description: Remember, you are of the Source. Unlike the halfmen here, you stand only to gain.

221.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05004_002090_EMETSELCH
221.description: Should you survive the remaining calamities, you will become our equal. A complete existence in a complete world.

222.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05004_002100_EMETSELCH
222.description: But such talk is a pleasure for later. Back to work, hero.

223.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05004_002110_EMETSELCH
223.description: Ah, there was one thing I had meant to ask.

224.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05004_002120_EMETSELCH
224.description: How well do you know the Exarch? Has he ever deigned to show you what hides beneath the cowl?

225.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05004_002130_EMETSELCH
225.description: What, <hex:021A020203>never<hex:021A020103>? Even to you? How <hex:021A020203>very<hex:021A020103> interesting...

226.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05004_002140_EMETSELCH
226.description: I shall enjoy working out what it means. Until next time.

227.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05004_002150_DULIACHAI
227.description: Ohhh, I knew you could do it, dearest! I never doubted you for a moment!

229.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05004_002170_WARRIOROFDARKNESS
229.description: I don't know if you remember, but when we first met in this world, I was all but spent.

230.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05004_002180_WARRIOROFDARKNESS
230.description: I never thought to wonder why until now.

231.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05004_002190_WARRIOROFDARKNESS
231.description: I think it all just got to be too much.

232.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05004_002200_WARRIOROFDARKNESS
232.description: The guilt of causing the Flood... Knowing everyone hated me... But the worst thing was the solitude.

233.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05004_002210_WARRIOROFDARKNESS
233.description: Time wears you down, aye...but solitude <hex:021A020203>eats<hex:021A020103> away at you. It was <hex:021A020203>this<hex:021A020103> close to finishing me off. But as bad as it got, and as empty as I felt...I can't even begin to imagine what it must be like for Emet-Selch.

234.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05004_002220_WARRIOROFDARKNESS
234.description: All of which is a long way of saying: don't make a choice that leaves you alone. Nothing is worth that─especially not eternity.

235.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05004_002230_ALPHINAUD
235.description: Glad tidings, my friend! The Ladder lives again!

236.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05004_002240_ALISAIE
236.description: The three of us have been invited to do the honors. Are you <hex:021A020203>up<hex:021A020103> for it? Of course, if you're worried that the whole thing might come crashing <hex:021A020203>down<hex:021A020103>, we can always find someone else.

237.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05004_002250_ALISAIE
237.description: That's the spirit! Come on, then!

238.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05004_002260_WARRIOROFDARKNESS
238.description: We rode the Ladder too, my comrades and I. Once upon a time.

239.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05004_002270_WARRIOROFDARKNESS
239.description: Watched the horizon grow and the town shrink below us...

240.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05004_002280_WARRIOROFDARKNESS
240.description: Awed and terrified in equal measure, we ascended without a word, the silence broken only by the rhythm of the gears.

241.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05004_002290_WARRIOROFDARKNESS
241.description: No one but me remembers that day.

242.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05004_002300_WARRIOROFDARKNESS
242.description: Remembers our journey...and our end. Retread the path─seek and you may yet find...

243.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05004_002310_ALISAIE
243.description: You're a sight for sore eyes. I don't know about you, but I bumped into quite a few sin eaters out there.

244.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05004_002320_ALISAIE
244.description: You too, then. It seems the closer we get to Mt. Gulg, the more of them there are.

245.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05004_002330_ALISAIE
245.description: Looks a lot bigger from here, doesn't it?

246.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05004_002340_ALISAIE
246.description: If I were Vauthry, the first thing I'd do is surround myself with as many sin eaters as I could lay my hands on.

247.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05004_002350_ALISAIE
247.description: And judging by the number we've already faced, his lordship is of the same mind.

248.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05004_002360_ALISAIE
248.description: This is going to be a tough climb.

249.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05004_002370_ALISAIE
249.description: But first things first: we need to determine if climbing is even an option. The more I look, the less likely it seems...

250.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05004_002380_ALISAIE
250.description: Y'shtola is right to be worried, but flying may be our only choice after all.

251.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05004_002390_URIANGER
251.description: There you are. Master Alphinaud was afeared you had met with some misfortune.

252.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05004_002400_ALISAIE
252.description: Urianger! ...And you too, Exarch! What brings you here?

253.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05004_002410_MYSTERYVOICE
253.description: I wish to observe the final struggle with my own eyes.

254.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05004_002420_MYSTERYVOICE
254.description: I arrived at the Bottom Rung too late to accompany you, but I was in time to join Urianger and the others.

255.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05004_002430_MYSTERYVOICE
255.description: Come, let us see how this unfolds.

256.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05004_002440_ALISAIE
256.description: Well, it seems flying is off the table.

257.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05004_002450_MYSTERYVOICE
257.description: If we have learned that much, then the machina have served their purpose.

258.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05004_002460_ALISAIE
258.description: Ah, so that's what they were for. Wasteful, but effective.

259.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05004_002470_URIANGER
259.description: 'Twould seem our foe will not be reached by land or air. We must needs withdraw to consider another course.

260.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05004_002480_URIANGER
260.description: Master Alphinaud waiteth for us at Top Rung. Thither should we make our way.

261.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05004_002490_THANCRED
261.description: ...In short, there's no path, and the sky is thick with Vauthry's winged devils.

262.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05004_002500_ALPHINAUD
262.description: We might consider amaro, but without extensive training, we cannot hope to contend with the eaters.

263.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05004_002510_ALPHINAUD
263.description: Eulmore's airship fleet, meanwhile, consists solely of transport vessels ill-suited for battle. And without the expertise of one such as Cid, we are in no position to attempt a refit.

264.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05004_002520_DULIACHAI
264.description: Oh, it's so <hex:021A020203>frustrating<hex:021A020103>! That wretched mountain should jolly well come back down to earth!

265.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05004_002530_CHAINUZZ
265.description: Now, now, dearest. We mustn't disturb these good people at their work.

266.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05004_002540_CHAINUZZ
266.description: We've ridden the Ladder and seen the sights. It's past time we took our leave.

267.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05004_002550_YSHTOLA
267.description: The lady may well have the right of it.

268.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05004_002560_YSHTOLA
268.description: Mt. Gulg will not soon come down to earth, nor can we compel it to do so. But if the mountain will not come to the land, mayhap the land may be made to come to the mountain...

269.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05004_002570_YSHTOLA
269.description: ...In the form of a Talos. A Talos large enough to reach out and take the volcano in its grasp.

270.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05004_002580_URIANGER
270.description: To build such a golem would be an onerous undertaking indeed...yet the principle seemeth sound in itself.

271.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05004_002590_CHAINUZZ
271.description: Balderdash! No one has ever made one even half that size!

272.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05004_002600_CHAINUZZ
272.description: Leaving aside the small matter of logistics─which, by the way, would be <hex:021A020203>no small matter<hex:021A020103>─the design would need to be <hex:021A020203>unimaginably<hex:021A020103> complex!

273.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05004_002610_CHAINUZZ
273.description: Though, I suppose... Hmm... If its only function is to cling to the ruddy mountain, perhaps it needn't be...

274.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05004_002620_CHAINUZZ
274.description: A solid base, firmly rooted to the ground─sacrifice mobility to simplify the construction, reducing materials required...

275.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05004_002630_CHAINUZZ
275.description: Wait, wait, wait! What am I thinking!? We would still need a veritable <hex:021A020203>army<hex:021A020103> of people to do the work!

276.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05004_002640_CHAINUZZ
276.description: Left to the crew that helped down below, it would take decades, if not a nice round century!

277.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05004_002650_ALISAIE
277.description: So we need more hands. And what sort of things would these hands be required to do?

278.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05004_002660_CHAINUZZ
278.description: Oh? Er... Well, er... Well, let's see... First, we'd need people to procure the stone for the chassis.

279.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05004_002670_CHAINUZZ
279.description: The rock found near the mountain would suit our purposes well enough. It'd be a simple task to quarry the stuff, but given the stupendous quantity required, we'd need all the help we can get.

280.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05004_002680_THANCRED
280.description: We have friends amongst the miners of Amh Araeng. I will go and petition their aid.

281.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05004_002690_ALISAIE
281.description: While you do that, I'll make for Mord Souq. I'm sure I'll be able to drum up some support.

282.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05004_002700_ALPHINAUD
282.description: Then I shall return to Kholusia.

283.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05004_002710_ALPHINAUD
283.description: From fishers to carpenters, Eulmore is home to all manner of talented folk. I daresay their skills will avail us.

284.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05004_002720_RYNE
284.description: Is there anything else you need?

285.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05004_002730_CHAINUZZ
285.description: Well...yes, actually... Magic. Lots of the stuff. As much as possible. To awaken a Talos of this size would require an entire congregation of mages.

286.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05004_002740_YSHTOLA
286.description: Many among the Night's Blessed are gifted in the arcane arts. I will recruit them to our cause.

287.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05004_002750_URIANGER
287.description: The fae folk too, possess surpassing aptitude in magicks. Yet they are not wont to cooperate in the endeavors of men. Leastwise, not without making all manner of mischief.

288.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05004_002760_URIANGER
288.description: That being the case, I would instead call upon the people of the Crystarium─with thy permission, Exarch.

289.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05004_002770_MYSTERYVOICE
289.description: We are at your disposal, as are our amaro and chocobos.

290.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05004_002780_CHAINUZZ
290.description: I'm sorry─you mean to tell me you can call on not only the people of Eulmore and the Crystarium, but the Night's Blessed, and the Mord, and even those miners!?

291.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05004_002790_CHAINUZZ
291.description: But that's just about everyone in bally Norvrandt!

292.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05004_002800_CHAINUZZ
292.description: Who <hex:021A020203>are<hex:021A020103> you people!? And how did you come to have so many <hex:021A020203>friends<hex:021A020103>!?

296.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05004_A5_000_003_NONE_VOICE
296.description: The artist Alphinaud and his assistants.

297.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05004_002810_CHAINUZZ
297.description: Saviors of the world? Are you being serious? Oh gods, you are...

298.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05004_002820_CHAINUZZ
298.description: No import? You expect me to believe that after you just promised me the help of the better part of the world!?

299.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05004_002830_DULIACHAI
299.description: Oh, dearest, have you forgotten already? Alphinaud told us that when we first met.

300.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05004_002840_CHAINUZZ
300.description: Um, actually, that may not have been... Never mind...

301.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05004_002850_YSHTOLA
301.description: So, as you can see, you will not want for bodies. I trust you will have your design ready in good time for their arrival.

302.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05004_002860_YSHTOLA
302.description: Norvrandt is counting on you...heir to Daedalus Stoneworks.

303.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05004_002870_RYNE
303.description: We'll be back as soon as we can─and we'll bring the whole world with us.

304.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05004_002880_MYSTERYVOICE
304.description: ...I take it we will be assisting Master Chai. Though I am quite sure he has everything under control...

305.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05004_002890_MYSTERYVOICE
305.description: The future is where my destiny awaits...

307.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05004_002910_MYSTERYVOICE
307.description: Forgive me, I was...lost in a dream.

308.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05004_002920_MYSTERYVOICE
308.description: I needed some fresh air, and thought to rest for a moment. It would seem I am more fatigued than I realized.

309.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05004_002930_MYSTERYVOICE
309.description: Too much time away from the tower, I fear. It drains me─leaves my body frail and weak.

310.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05004_002940_MYSTERYVOICE
310.description: Though, in truth, it is debatable whether I can still call this my body...

311.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05004_002950_MYSTERYVOICE
311.description: When first I turned my mind towards the salvation of the world, I came to the conclusion that it would take many long years. Many more than remained to me.

312.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05004_002960_MYSTERYVOICE
312.description: And so I made myself one with the Crystal Tower, that I might live indefinitely.

313.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05004_002970_MYSTERYVOICE
313.description: I am but an extension of it now. Hence my weakness the farther I travel, and the longer I am away.

314.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05004_002980_MYSTERYVOICE
314.description: It has been quite a journey.

315.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05004_002990_MYSTERYVOICE
315.description: But thanks to you, the end is in sight. My wish will finally be fulfilled.

317.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05004_003010_MYSTERYVOICE
317.description: Then this may be the last moment we have to ourselves for a while. Come, sit with me.

318.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05004_003020_MYSTERYVOICE
318.description: Tell me, when all of this is over, what will you do?

320.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05004_A6_000_001_NONE_VOICE
320.description: I'll settle matters with the Empire.

321.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05004_A6_000_002_NONE_VOICE
321.description: What I always do: seek out mightier foes.

324.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05004_003030_MYSTERYVOICE
324.description: Ah, yes. Even should we succeed in forestalling the Eighth Umbral Calamity, the specter of war will remain.

325.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05004_003040_MYSTERYVOICE
325.description: But to declare your intent with such easy resolve... You truly are a heroes' hero, my friend.

326.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05004_003050_MYSTERYVOICE
326.description: In the hundred years they have existed, no one had come close to ridding us of even a <hex:021A020203>single<hex:021A020103> Lightwarden. Yet already you yearn for the next challenge. You truly are a world apart from us all.

327.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05004_003060_MYSTERYVOICE
327.description: That would be well deserved. You might consider roaming Norvrandt not as her savior, but as a simple sightseer. Viewed through such eyes, I am certain she would seem quite different.

328.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05004_003070_MYSTERYVOICE
328.description: Well, you needn't hurry to decide. I was merely curious to know what sort of future lay in store for a hero with <hex:02080DE905FF04686572FF0468697303> life ahead of <hex:02080DE905FF04686572FF0468696D03>.

329.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05004_003080_MYSTERYVOICE
329.description: But whatever it is you decide to do, I have every confidence that you will do well. For you have the strength to forge your own path.

330.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05004_003090_MYSTERYVOICE
330.description: You will leave countless lives better than you found them, and the souls you touch will never forget your kindness.

331.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05004_003100_MYSTERYVOICE
331.description: Then, in trying times, when you question your worth and your choices, they will raise their voices to remind you of the difference you have made.

332.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05004_003110_MYSTERYVOICE
332.description: And thus will your deeds come to affirm your path. Remember this.

334.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05004_A7_000_001_NONE_VOICE
334.description: What will <hex:021A020203>you<hex:021A020103> do when this is over?

335.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05004_A7_000_002_NONE_VOICE
335.description: I would know more of you.

337.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05004_003130_MYSTERYVOICE
337.description: Of <hex:021A020203>me<hex:021A020103>? You mean what I intend to do afterwards?

338.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05004_003140_MYSTERYVOICE
338.description: I once told you that there are things we can ill afford to lose.

339.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05004_003150_MYSTERYVOICE
339.description: "Things,“ I said, though in truth I spoke of a person. One who is unaware of the full extent of my plans. Though he deserves to know, I have good reason to keep my counsel.

340.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05004_003160_MYSTERYVOICE
340.description: “Things,” I said, though in truth I spoke of a person. One who is unaware of the full extent of my plans. Though she deserves to know, I have good reason to keep my counsel.

341.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05004_003170_MYSTERYVOICE
341.description: I have come to terms with this in my mind, yet my heart yearns to lay everything bare. For <hex:02080CE905FF04736865FF03686503> is my inspiration, and I would give much and more for the chance to speak with <hex:02080DE905FF04686572FF0468696D03> as friends, with no thought of concealment.

342.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05004_003180_MYSTERYVOICE
342.description: Should <hex:02080CE905FF04736865FF03686503> indulge me with <hex:02080DE905FF04686572FF0468697303> tales, I would regale <hex:02080DE905FF04686572FF0468696D03> with my own─about my efforts in Norvrandt, perhaps.

343.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05004_003190_MYSTERYVOICE
343.description: Though...ultimately, that tale is more yours than it is mine.

344.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05004_003200_MYSTERYVOICE
344.description: Then...I would ask <hex:02080DE905FF04686572FF0468696D03> about <hex:02080DE905FF04686572FF0468697303> next adventure. And if <hex:02080CE905FF04736865FF03686503> should wish me to be a part of it, oh...how happy it would make me.

345.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05004_003210_MYSTERYVOICE
345.description: Together, we would travel the lands and cross the seas and take to the skies upon the eternal wind... My heart swells simply to imagine it.

346.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05004_003220_MYSTERYVOICE
346.description: But all of this is contingent upon our victory in the coming battle.

347.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05004_003230_MYSTERYVOICE
347.description: The people of this world have entrusted their hopes to us. We cannot fail them.

348.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05004_003240_MYSTERYVOICE
348.description: ...Nor those who roused me from my slumber.

349.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05004_003250_MYSTERYVOICE
349.description: Thank you for your company, my friend. Let us return to Amity.

350.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05004_003260_YSHTOLA
350.description: Word from the Exarch. All is set on his side, and we may proceed when ready.

351.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05004_003270_THANCRED
351.description: Well, we have sufficient stone for our needs.

352.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05004_003280_URIANGER
352.description: Likewise, preparations for the imbuing have been made according to thine exacting instructions.

353.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05004_003290_ALPHINAUD
353.description: Then you need only say the word!

354.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05004_003300_YSHTOLA
354.description: Let us begin. See that everyone is in position.

355.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05004_003310_YSHTOLA
355.description: We shall catch Vauthry, mountain and all!

357.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05004_003330_CHAINUZZ
357.description: Hah hah! Yes! <hex:021A020203>Yes<hex:021A020103>! You've not lost your touch, you clever old bugger!

358.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05004_003340_CHAINUZZ
358.description: Do you see what they're doing!? If its hands are damaged, it won't be able to cling to the mountain! Oh, I <hex:021A020203>knew<hex:021A020103> this was a terrible idea!

359.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05004_003350_MYSTERYVOICE
359.description: Vauthry marshals the eaters to his defense. This was only to be expected.

360.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05004_003360_MYSTERYVOICE
360.description: We must try and draw as many of them down to the ground as possible. It may not be enough, but we have no other choice.

362.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05004_003380_FEOUL
362.description: Such a heartless thing our sapling is! Cold and cruel and <hex:021A020203>heartless<hex:021A020103>!

363.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05004_003390_FEOUL
363.description: Summon us in times of need, we <hex:021A020203>expressly<hex:021A020103> said─yet what should we find but the final battle joined without so much as a <hex:021A020203>whisper<hex:021A020103> of our name!

364.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05004_003400_FEOUL
364.description: Yes, yes, we may also have said that we fae folk have no interest in the struggles of men─

365.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05004_003410_FEOUL
365.description: But if our <hex:021A020203>adorable<hex:021A020103> sapling had come crying to us for help, we would of <hex:021A020203>course<hex:021A020103> have flown to <hex:02080DE905FF04686572FF0468697303> aid! Of course we would! What are we to do with <hex:02080DE905FF04686572FF0468696D03>?

366.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05004_003420_FEOUL
366.description: We are so very, very sad. <hex:021A020203>You<hex:021A020103> will play with us. <hex:021A020203>Cheer us up again<hex:021A020103>!

369.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05004_A8_000_002_NONE_VOICE
369.description: I think they're mad at me...

370.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05004_003430_MYSTERYVOICE
370.description: This I did not expect. But I will gladly accept the help.

371.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05004_003440_MYSTERYVOICE
371.description: I will send word to Y'shtola and the others. Join them at the foot of Mt. Gulg and be ready to make the ascent!

372.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05004_003450_ALPHINAUD
372.description: The end is near, my friends. We have found Vauthry's hiding place.

373.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05004_003460_VAUTHRY
373.description: (-Vauthry-)Unrepentant villains. Will you not be satisfied until you have brought disaster down upon your own heads?

374.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05004_003470_VAUTHRY
374.description: (-Vauthry-)By your wickedness, you stand to gain naught but ceaseless conflict!

375.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05004_003480_VAUTHRY
375.description: (-Vauthry-)Had you only entrusted your fate to me, there would have been peace for all.

376.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05004_003490_VAUTHRY
376.description: (-Vauthry-)You could have lived in bliss in my eternal paradise, free from the burdens of conscience and purpose!

377.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05004_003500_ALPHINAUD
377.description: Peace assumes many forms, and I do not doubt that you considered yours well worth the cost. I was even prepared to believe that the end might justify the means.

378.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05004_003510_ALPHINAUD
378.description: Ignorant as I was, I had hoped that you might mend your ways and join hands with us. That we might strive together for the happiness of all...

379.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05004_003520_ALPHINAUD
379.description: ...But no more. Your actions cannot be reconciled with your words.

380.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05004_003530_ALPHINAUD
380.description: "Peace for all,“ you say, yet when you were threatened, your first act was to sacrifice your own people in order to save yourself.

381.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05004_003540_ALPHINAUD
381.description: If your paradise can be rebuilt so long as you alone survive, it exists not for the people. It exists solely for your twisted pleasure!

382.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05004_003550_RYNE
382.description: Hear me, Vauthry. The people won't submit to your will. For we each have our own.

383.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05004_003560_RYNE
383.description: I made a promise to a noble soul─a woman who saw fit to entrust me with her legacy─and I mean to keep it.

384.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05004_003570_RYNE
384.description: Everyone who stands with us has something precious, something that they cherish and would die to protect.

385.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05004_003580_RYNE
385.description: They know their own hearts. They know what they want for this world.

386.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05004_003590_RYNE
386.description: And by lending their strength to our cause, they have spoken!

387.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05004_003600_RYNE
387.description: No matter how hard you may try to bend the world to your will, we will never yield!

389.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05004_003620_VAUTHRY
389.description: (-Vauthry-)You presume to lecture me? Insolent worms! You will learn your place!

390.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05004_003630_VAUTHRY
390.description: (-Vauthry-)With my true powers awakened, I will expunge you like the filth you are. Your demise will serve as a reminder to all─

391.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05004_003640_VAUTHRY
391.description: (-Vauthry-)That <hex:021A020203>I<hex:021A020103> am the zenith of mankind and sin eater both, chosen to rule over creation by right of transcendence!

392.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05004_003650_VAUTHRY
392.description: (-Vauthry-)My very existence is virtuous! I am perfect! <hex:021A020203>Immaculate<hex:021A020103>!

393.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05004_003660_YSHTOLA
393.description: He seems disinclined to grant us an audience.

394.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05004_003670_ALPHINAUD
394.description: Find Vauthry. We will hold the eaters here.

396.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05004_003690_VAUTHRY
396.description: Why? Why am <hex:021A020203>I<hex:021A020103> cast down...when it is <hex:021A020203>you<hex:021A020103> who are the villains?

397.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05004_003700_VAUTHRY
397.description: Father told me...that I am hope. I am righteousness. That I am...a <hex:021A020203>god<hex:021A020103>...

398.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05004_003710_VAUTHRY
398.description: That is why I was born...as man and sin eater both...

399.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05004_003720_VAUTHRY
399.description: I kept the people safe! They respected me! Worshipped me!

400.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05004_003730_VAUTHRY
400.description: How can this be? I should be the one...looking down at you...

401.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05004_003740_VAUTHRY
401.description: Help me, damn you... I...am your god...

403.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05004_003760_OLDEULMOREMAYOR
403.description: Fools! Were it not for my decisive action, the whole city would have been overrun! Razed to the ground!

404.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05004_003770_OLDEULMOREMAYOR
404.description: Yet they dare to complain about casualties? Spare me.

405.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05004_003780_OLDEULMOREMAYOR
405.description: I'll wager they were put up to it by those wretches who seek to usurp me. They're stirring up the citizenry.

406.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05004_003790_OLDEULMOREMAYOR
406.description: But if they think I will yield to the likes of them, they are gravely mistaken!

407.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05004_003800_EMETSELCH
407.description: (-???-)To be subjected to such deplorable treatment... Such ingratitude! You have my sympathies, sir. You do so much good for this city, and you could do so much more, were you not surrounded by fools...

408.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05004_003810_OLDEULMOREMAYOR
408.description: Who are you!? You're not supposed to be in here!

409.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05004_003820_EMETSELCH
409.description: My apologies for the intrusion, but I come bearing a proposal. One that will ensure the longevity of your reign.

410.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05004_003830_EMETSELCH
410.description: But give me the word, sir, and I will bring hither a Lightwarden.

411.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05004_003840_EMETSELCH
411.description: By giving its power to the babe within your lady wife's womb, we shall create a transcendent being─a king to rule over all. And as sire to the king, your authority will never again be in question.

412.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05004_003850_OLDEULMOREMAYOR
412.description: Haha! Amazing! Before my Vauthry, they behave as docile pets!

413.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05004_003860_OLDEULMOREMAYOR
413.description: With this gift, my line shall be guaranteed power for perpetuity! We shall rule the whole world!

414.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05004_003870_EMETSELCH
414.description: By all means, sir. United under Eulmore's banner, men will cease fighting and abandon their ambitions.

415.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05004_003880_EMETSELCH
415.description: Thus they will grow fat and complacent, and in their sloth seal your supremacy...

416.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05004_003890_ALISAIE
416.description: Are you all right!? S-Say something!

417.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05004_003900_YSHTOLA
417.description: Twelve forfend, he cannot contain the Light. He's beginning to turn!

418.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05004_003910_YSHTOLA
418.description: Twelve forfend, she cannot contain the Light. She's beginning to turn!

419.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05004_003920_YSHTOLA
419.description: Urianger! If you've aught up your sleeve, now is the time!

421.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05004_003940_MYSTERYVOICE
421.description: The combined power of every Lightwarden is too terrible a burden for any one soul to bear.

422.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05004_003950_MYSTERYVOICE
422.description: And so I shall relieve you of it.

424.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05004_003970_MYSTERYVOICE
424.description: I will channel this profusion of power to the Crystal Tower and use it to travel to other worlds.

425.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05004_003980_MYSTERYVOICE
425.description: As I have dreamed of doing ever since I first learned of their existence!

426.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05004_003990_MYSTERYVOICE
426.description: Who would choose to remain here, in this dying realm, when they might go elsewhere and begin anew? Not I. And thus...thus did I <hex:021A020203>use<hex:021A020103> you!

427.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05004_004000_RYNE
427.description: No... No, I don't believe you! It doesn't make sense!

428.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05004_004010_ALISAIE
428.description: Damn you! We won't let you do with <hex:02080DE905FF04686572FF0468696D03> as you please!

430.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05004_004030_URIANGER
430.description: Please! I beseech you all! <hex:021A020203>Let him go<hex:021A020103>!

432.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05004_004050_YSHTOLA
432.description: 'Tis all a fiction. Such vaguely defined acts of teleportation stand no chance of success.

433.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05004_004060_YSHTOLA
433.description: The Exarch will never live to see another world─as he knows only too well.

434.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05004_004070_ALPHINAUD
434.description: Then...what does he mean to do?

435.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05004_004080_YSHTOLA
435.description: He means to take the Light with him into the rift...where he will die.

436.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05004_004090_YSHTOLA
436.description: He means to take the Light with him into the rift...where he will die.

437.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05004_004100_YSHTOLA
437.description: From the beginning, he intended to sacrifice himself to save our friend and Norvrandt.

438.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05004_004110_MYSTERYVOICE
438.description: At journey's end, an opportunistic thief makes off with the hero's prize.

439.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05004_004120_MYSTERYVOICE
439.description: A paltry way to end a chapter, I concede.

440.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05004_004130_MYSTERYVOICE
440.description: Yet your tale will continue, and my role in it will scarcely be remembered.

441.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05004_004140_MYSTERYVOICE
441.description: Worry not. Whatever should become of me, I will be happy and free, safe in the knowledge that I have played my part.

445.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05004_004150_MYSTERYVOICE
445.description: Thank you for fighting for this world. For believing.

446.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05004_004160_MYSTERYVOICE
446.description: Fare you well, my friend─my inspiration.

447.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05004_004170_MYSTERYVOICE
447.description: Thank you for fighting for this world. For believing.

448.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05004_004180_MYSTERYVOICE
448.description: Fare you well, my friend─my inspiration.

449.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05004_004190_EMETSELCH
449.description: Only those who possess the Royal Eye of the Allagan imperial line are capable of controlling the Crystal Tower. Such individuals do not exist in the First.

450.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05004_004200_EMETSELCH
450.description: Therefore, in all likelihood, the Exarch arrived here with the tower. This much I had surmised, yet I could not discern his grand scheme.

451.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05004_004210_EMETSELCH
451.description: To think that he went through all this trouble for the sake of a single hero. It's almost admirable in its absurdity.

452.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05004_004220_EMETSELCH
452.description: Alas, it is not your grand scheme that will succeed, but ours.

454.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05004_004240_EMETSELCH
454.description: Stay put. Your friend is still alive, but whether he remains so depends on you.

455.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05004_004250_EMETSELCH
455.description: What a disappointment you turned out to be.

456.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05004_004260_EMETSELCH
456.description: I placed my faith in you. Let myself believe that you could contain the Light.

457.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05004_004270_EMETSELCH
457.description: But look at you now, halfway to becoming a monster. You are unworthy of my patronage.

459.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05004_A10_000_001_NONE_VOICE
459.description: What do you intend to do?

460.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05004_A10_000_002_NONE_VOICE
460.description: It was you who created Vauthry, wasn't it?

462.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05004_004290_EMETSELCH
462.description: I am an Ascian. My heart's sole desire is to usher in the Great Rejoining.

463.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05004_004300_EMETSELCH
463.description: A hundred years ago, I entrusted my comrade Loghrif with the task of increasing Light's sway over this world. This we sought to do by manipulating heroes.

464.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05004_004310_EMETSELCH
464.description: When that failed to achieve the desired result, I created Vauthry.

465.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05004_004320_EMETSELCH
465.description: But thanks to your meddling, that too has ended in failure.

466.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05004_004330_ALPHINAUD
466.description: What was your true purpose in approaching us?

467.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05004_004340_EMETSELCH
467.description: By your Twelve, boy, have I not told you before that everything I said was the truth?

468.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05004_004350_EMETSELCH
468.description: You were specimens by which I might gauge man's potential as it stands.

469.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05004_004360_EMETSELCH
469.description: I genuinely had an interest in you. Genuinely considered taking you on as allies.

470.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05004_004370_EMETSELCH
470.description: Provided <hex:021A020203><hex:02080CE905FF04736865FF03686503><hex:021A020103> could contain and control the Light.

471.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05004_004380_EMETSELCH
471.description: If not then <hex:02080CE905FF04736865FF03686503>─and by extension you─would be of no use to me. 'Twas as simple as that.

472.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05004_004390_THANCRED
472.description: So we've been found wanting. How disheartening.

473.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05004_004400_THANCRED
473.description: But even had we fulfilled your conditions, there was no guarantee that we would cooperate. What then?

474.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05004_004410_EMETSELCH
474.description: Then I simply kill you all. At the very least, it would restore the world to the way it was before you went about trouncing Lightwardens willy-nilly.

475.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05004_004420_EMETSELCH
475.description: Suffice it to say it would be most inconvenient to have all that Light taken away─and I would be lying if I were to claim his actions didn't have me worried.

476.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05004_004430_EMETSELCH
476.description: Hm, you still retain your form and your senses...but you have all but become a sin eater.

477.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05004_004440_EMETSELCH
477.description: Whether you will it or no, your mere existence will serve to engulf the world in Light.

478.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05004_004450_EMETSELCH
478.description: Those in your company will likewise turn into sin eaters, and in time you will succumb to your base instincts and hunt innocents to feast on their sweet, sweet aether.

479.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05004_004460_EMETSELCH
479.description: Those few with the will left to fight may rise up against you. But before your absolute might, they will quickly know despair.

480.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05004_004470_EMETSELCH
480.description: "There is no hope! We are finished! <hex:021A020203>Mankind<hex:021A020103> is finished!“

481.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05004_004480_EMETSELCH
481.description: Ahhh, the irony. What Vauthry achieved through bliss, you will achieve through despair.

482.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05004_004490_EMETSELCH
482.description: But I have overstayed my welcome. I shall look forward to seeing you bring the world to its knees, hero.

484.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05004_004510_EMETSELCH
484.description: I have naught to show for all the time and effort I invested in you. He is a small token for my troubles.

485.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05004_004520_EMETSELCH
485.description: I did not expect that I could learn aught from man, but I may yet learn something from all the knowledge he had hoarded for his precious hero.

487.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05004_004540_EMETSELCH
487.description: Your friends are now your foes. If you do not kill them, they will kill you.

488.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05004_004550_EMETSELCH
488.description: When it all becomes too much to bear, seek me out at my abode, in the dark depths of the Tempest.

489.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05004_004560_EMETSELCH
489.description: There, you may complete your descent into madness with some dignity, far from prying eyes.

490.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05004_004570_EMETSELCH
490.description: Till then, I bid you farewell...eater.

497.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05004_004610_WARRIOROFDARKNESS
497.description: Then Ryne did what she could to stay the raging of the Light within your body.

498.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05004_004620_WARRIOROFDARKNESS
498.description: Thanks to her, you're still you, but she's only delayed the inevitable.

499.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05004_004630_WARRIOROFDARKNESS
499.description: You're not going to like what you see, but you still need to see it.

500.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05004_004640_WARRIOROFDARKNESS
500.description: It's like this all over. The whole of Norvrandt is shrouded in Light again.

501.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05004_004650_WARRIOROFDARKNESS
501.description: And it's because of you and the power you absorbed from the Wardens.

502.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05004_004660_WARRIOROFDARKNESS
502.description: No one knows but your friends.

503.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05004_004670_WARRIOROFDARKNESS
503.description: When they carried you down from the mountain, they told everyone waiting below that they didn't understand why the Light had returned.

504.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05004_004680_WARRIOROFDARKNESS
504.description: And now they're out there trying to allay the people's fears while searching for a way to save you.

505.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05004_004690_WARRIOROFDARKNESS
505.description: If you're well enough to be up, you're well enough to get some fresh air. Better that than stewing in here. Go on. Go.
